limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the red-to-green and green-to-yellow branches but replaced the registered light-output pipeline with combinational decoding, changing the reset lights and post-reset countdown timing that the reference fix preserves.
The test expected red with a count of 9 on the first edge after reset release, so it validated the rewrite’s startup timing rather than checking that the original timing was preserved.
